description: Per-stock DCA: all positive first orders start at $1.00; later amounts are precise historical-drop tiers.
method: Per ticker, the 5th..100th percentiles (96 tiers) of the last 90 days of adjusted prior-close-to-low drops map to a log-scaled 1.00x..10.00x curve (8.00x at the 95th, 10.00x at the 100th = the window's largest drop).
